title: Towards Physics-Constrained Rectified Flow for Climate Downscaling: What Projections Can Certify?
abstract: arXiv:2611.22283v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Statistical downscaling restores the regional detail behind flooding and crop stress, but diffusion and flow-matching generators can produce sharp fields that break the conservation laws of their coarse input. Physics-Constrained Rectified Flow (PC-RF) is a conditional flow-matching downscaler. Its training penalties target wind divergence, negative precipitation, and mass drift from the coarse total, and a projection after sampling removes the last two exactly. On one corrupted synthetic field with no trained network, the projection drives the Non-negativity Violation Rate (NVR) from 0.236 and the Mass-Conservation Error (MCE) from 0.184 to zero, and the penalties lower the Divergence Error (DE) by about 30%. On ERA5 the projection gives PC-RF and RF-base, the penalty-free rectified-flow baseline, an NVR of exactly zero and an MCE of zero up to float32 rounding. translated_title: 迈向气候降尺度中的物理约束整流流：投影能证明什么？
translated_abstract: 统计降尺度能够恢复洪水和作物胁迫背后的区域细节，但扩散模型和流匹配生成器可能产生违反其粗分辨率输入守恒定律的锐利场。物理约束整流流是一种条件流匹配降尺度器。其训练惩罚项针对风场散度、负降水以及相对于粗分辨率总量的质量漂移，而采样后的投影可以精确消除后两者。在一个无需训练网络的受损合成场上，投影将非负性违反率（NVR）从0.236、质量守恒误差（MCE）从0.184降至零，同时惩罚项将散度误差（DE）降低约30%。在ERA5数据集上，投影使PC-RF和无惩罚整流流基线RF-base的非负性违反率精确为零，且质量守恒误差在float32舍入精度内为零。这些惩罚项并未带来能够从训练预算中分离出来的感知增益。
tldr: 提出物理约束整流流（PC-RF）气候降尺度方法，通过训练惩罚项与采样后投影将降水非负性违反率和质量守恒误差精确降为零，并将散度误差降低约30%。
en_tdlr: Proposes Physics-Constrained Rectified Flow (PC-RF) for climate downscaling, which combines training penalties with a post-sampling projection to exactly eliminate non-negativity violations and mass conservation errors while reducing divergence error by about 30%.
